items.title: Iran blocks UN nuclear site visits until war ends

The ministry's statement follows calls for the UN watchdog to resume inspections of nuclear sites, which have been suspended since last year's 12-day war with Israel.

The tornado reached 160 metres wide, had a path length of 4.4 miles (7.1km) and reached estimated peak winds of up to 100mph (161km/h).
